# Shore rock source

Rock_Medium_1, Rock_Medium_2 and Rock_Medium_3 plus Rocks_Diffuse.png, from the same official Quaternius Stylized Nature MegaKit Standard CC0 archive documented in the parent folder. The parent License_Standard.txt applies. No new download or purchase.

`node scripts/import-shore-rocks.mjs art/third-party/quaternius/shore-rocks GolfArcade/Resources/Nature`

Preserves source topology, normals and UVs; centers the horizontal bounds, sets the base to zero and uniformly normalizes the horizontal radius to one yard. Bundled color texture is reduced to 1024px; editable original retained here. Runtime uses deterministic small rotations/scales, partly buried placement and terrain clearance. No golfer or tree asset is rewritten.
